definitions: Beat (a person or animal) with a whip or similar instrument.
Beat (cream, eggs, or other food) vigorously with a whisk or fork to incorporate air.
Move or take something out, or move oneself, quickly and suddenly.
Achieve a specified state or result by or as if by whipping.
examples: He whipped the horse to make it go faster.
She whipped the cream until it was stiff.
He whipped out his phone to take a picture.
The team whipped the opposition in the final match.
